Job Title: Principal - Package Implementation

Location: Bengaluru

Experience: 16-20 years

About the Role: Join LTM as a Principal - Package Implementation to lead strategic digitalization initiatives. Drive high-impact transformation for global operations by bridging plant business processes with advanced SAP enterprise solutions, ensuring long-term business value.

Role and Responsibilities (What You'll Do):

  • Partner with business subject matter experts to identify operational needs and translate them into strategic requirements for MTMNG solutions.
  • Collaborate with solution experts and cross-functional teams to identify capability gaps and drive the evolution of digital platforms.
  • Provide expert advisory support to stakeholders for shaping digital transformation roadmaps and executing sequential, high-value implementations.
  • Coordinate local validation activities for system setups and new releases while monitoring long-term operational solution adoption.
  • Foster strong relationships with core business representatives, architects, and users to ensure seamless digital integration across manufacturing units.
  • Drive continuous process optimization by leveraging lean and agile concepts to maximize operational efficiency and value creation.
  • Facilitate regular on-site alignment through scheduled visits to client offices in C V Raman Nagar Bagmane and manufacturing plants in Hoskote.

Qualifications (What You'll Bring):

Must-Have:

  • Extensive proficiency in configuring, mapping, and implementing SAP Warehouse Management modules within complex manufacturing environments.
  • Proven expertise in business process analysis, requirement gathering, gap identification, and aligning enterprise solutions with operational targets.
  • Demonstrated experience in driving lean and agile digitalization initiatives to optimize supply chain, logistics, and plant operations.

Preferred:

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related business discipline.
  • Deep domain expertise in the manufacturing and automotive sectors with a comprehensive understanding of ERP ecosystems.
  • Exceptional strategic leadership, cross-functional stakeholder management, and analytical problem-solving competencies.
